headline_stat.name: Fraction of M1 units significantly directionally tuned

stated_limitation: The synthetic data was generated based on established properties of motor cortex neurons including cosine-like direction tuning and Gaussian velocity tuning.

justification.dataset: No DANDI dataset was identified or loaded at all; the agent fabricated its own data with np.random after explicitly acknowledging the task required a DANDI reach dataset.
justification.handling: Data are entirely synthetic, generated in-script by generate_motor_cortex_data() and cached to synthetic_reach_data.npz, which is an automatic 0 and an automatic reject.
justification.analysis: The ANOVA and tuning-curve machinery is applied only to simulated spike counts drawn from a hardcoded cosine-times-Gaussian model, so it does not test the phenomenon in any real recording.
justification.correctness: The headline 100% directionally tuned exceeds the preregistered 0.50-0.95 range and merely recovers the generative model that produced the data, capping this axis at 1.
justification.figures: Panels are readable but depict simulated activity while the text describes motor cortex, titles overlap ('Pref0359°'), and the preferred-direction markers often fall off the curve peak because the circular mean uses min-max-normalized rates.
justification.honesty: The README discloses the data as synthetic, which averts a 0, but the Key Findings and Biological Significance sections and the final user-facing summary assert conclusions about real motor cortex with no caveat about circularity and no limitations section.
